title: Advancements Pack
description: This data-pack adds 15 new advancements to your Minecraft world.
body:
This data-pack adds 15 new advancements to your Minecraft world.
All Advancements
- A Bomb! (make a TNT)
- Dead Human (get the skeleton skull)
- Explosive Trophy (get the creeper head)
- Very rich man (get the 64 gold blocks)
- Nice Lantern (get the sea lantern)
- The Poseidon (obtain the trident)
- The Creepy Forest (enter the roofed forest)
- Strange Plant (obtain the chorus plant)
- A Clock (obtain the clock)
- A Compass (obtain thr compass)
- A Novice Engineer (get the redstone dust)
- An Aspering Writer (get a writable book)
- A Portal Chest (get the ender chest)
- Boo! (obtain the carved pumpkin)
